utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the sixth of March. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Bit tinny, but that's probably this headset.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Before we start— the football last night. Honestly, ninety minutes I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You say that every Friday. Still watch it, though.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And the broken coffee machine in the canteen isn't helping. That's a moan, by the way, not another job for this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Try the heating in the portakabin. I'm sat here in my coat. Also just moaning, before anyone puts my name against anything.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Very efficient meeting so far. Football, coffee, being cold.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, yeah, factory stuff. Anything already closed out first?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I tested the 11kV board yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, so that's a completed item, not another test we're trying to fit in today?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. Just giving you the result.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the CT1 last night. That's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Good. Two things off rather than six things on, for once.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just an observation from nights: noticed the palletizer was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Settled before the end of nights, you mean?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah. Not raising any work off that, just passing on what happened.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And my existing blocker hasn't changed. I can't get to the line three until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Still blocked, then; that's not a fresh instruction to go in today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the MV01 by Wednesday? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the MV01 by Wednesday. Understood on doing that first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Han. That's agreed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, I'll check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 1 this morning. Normal priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tom. Guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 1, this morning, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep. That's the one I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over the end of that. Heard you now.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll schedule downtime for the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit with production by Thursday. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—I've got that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Cal. By Thursday for getting the downtime scheduled, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly, that's the scheduling bit. Not saying all the work happens on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Separate from that, Callum, can you swap the filter on the line one HPU by 11am? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll swap the filter on the line one HPU by 11am. That gets the urgent slot.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, I nearly bundled those together in my head. Two separate commitments, then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Filter by 11am; scheduling the downtime by Thursday. Not waiting for Thursday to do the filter.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. The filter and the MV01 sign-off are the production-holding ones, not routine items.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I've got the MV01 sign-off first on mine, by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum, can you send the shift handover report round as well, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round whenever I get a chance. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The glamorous side of production.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Living the dream. Mostly in a spreadsheet.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I'll do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet next Tuesday. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Forklift Fleet pre-use checks next Tuesday, normal priority, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, next Tuesday for mine.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, was that Tuesday or Thursday? Teams swallowed the middle.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Tuesday. The Forklift Fleet pre-use checks are next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: There's still the permit gap, though. Someone needs to sort the permit to work and isolation for the line 3 at half two. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Who can take that? At half two is the timing, but sorting that safety-critical gap needs attention straight away.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't take it. Like I said, can't get to the line three until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'm not taking ownership of that either. Don't put it against me because I'm on the call.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No offer from me on that one, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: So we haven't actually got anyone accepting it?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No. I'm flagging the gap, not volunteering for the permit or the isolation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hearing no taker. The permit to work and isolation for the line 3 at half two is still unowned. That one's safety critical, straight away—not something we're calling covered.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, don't want a mention in a stand-up being mistaken for a signed permit.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. Still a gap, not an agreed isolation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Nobody's accepted that one, and this conversation isn't authorisation to proceed.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. That's clear now. Bit of a difference between being on the list and being sorted.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Mine are clear: filter on the line one HPU by 11am, first because it's holding production up. Schedule downtime for the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit with production by Thursday—not an emergency, but don't let it slip. Handover report whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I'll check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 1 this morning, normal priority. The line three access is still blocked, separate thing.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I've got the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the MV01 by Wednesday, first because it's holding production up. And the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet next Tuesday, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Those commitments are agreed; the line 3 permit and isolation remains unowned. That's the position, no pretending otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep. Heard.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, thanks all. And no, this call has not magically fixed the coffee machine either. See you on the floor.
